bar.page_text:
Lumen Ledger
How it works
Plans
Help
See your bills at a glance

Lumen Ledger sorts every household bill into clear groups, so each month reads like a short story.

Start a free ledger
Every bill in its place

Rent, food and travel each get a group, and the ledger keeps them tidy for you.

What the ledger tracks
Rent and housing
Food and groceries
Travel and fuel
Power and water
Phone and internet
Gifts and treats

Fictional demo — no real accounts or payments.
